exposure: Structured Instructional Program on Home-based Newborn Care
outcome: Mothers' practice regarding home-based newborn care
cohort: 100 mothers (50 in a control group and 50 in a study group) who underwent cesarean section and were admitted to the maternity department at Baghdad Teaching Hospital.
finding: The structured instructional program significantly improved mothers' practice concerning home-based newborn care during the postpartum period after cesarean section.
mod_finding: The study found extremely good effectiveness of the instructional program for mothers who delivered by cesarean section.
